description:
Real-time clicks-per-second (CPS) counter that catches every click from a low-level mouse hook.

ClickMeter tracks your click rate in real time with no overhead. It counts every click straight from a low-level mouse hook, so nothing slips past — even rapid or injected bursts that browser-based testers miss. Track left, right, or middle clicks, alone or combined. Live CPS updates instantly, peak and session average stay visible, and a configurable history chart shows anywhere from the last 30 seconds up to your full session. Tiny binary, zero telemetry, entirely local.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.

- Version 1.1.0. ClickMeter counts every click you make, but its own version number went 1.0.9, 1.0.10. We taught it to count
- Nothing else changed since 1.0.10. New since 1.0.9:
- Same font and text sizes as the other TAPATCH apps
- New UI size in Settings → Size and window: text, buttons and panels get bigger or smaller together (60–200%). Ctrl + and Ctrl − work too, Ctrl 0 goes back to 100%
- The window opens where you left it, on the same screen and at the same size. Or pick Full screen under When the window opens
- Startup window size is replaced by Size and window: ClickMeter now opens at the place and size you left it
license_or_tos: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
